key_path: `npx clerk init` (or `clerk init -y` in agent mode) with no account: 'get started immediately with temporary development keys' (keyless mode)
App works locally right away with dev keys
Later (optional): `clerk auth login` (browser) + `clerk link` to claim/attach to an account; `clerk env pull` writes real keys
human_gates: email_verification / OAuth login only when claiming or going to production

agent_native_auth.cli_browser_or_device_login: yes: `clerk auth login`; CLI detects non-TTY and switches to agent mode with JSON output and --input-json
agent_native_auth.oauth_dcr_for_mcp: Clerk's own MCP is a docs/snippets server (no account needed). As an enabler, Clerk's OAuth server supports DCR, CIMD and Device Authorization Grant for customers' MCP servers
agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mints_keys: yes: Platform API (`clerk apps create`, `clerk api --platform`), Backend API for API keys/M2M machines
agent_native_auth.scoped_keys: yes: dev vs prod instances; M2M machine scopes; API keys per user/org
agent_native_auth.test_dev_instances: yes: every app has development + production instances
agent_native_auth.keyless_claimable_dev_mode: yes: temporary development keys without an account, claimable later

mcp.docs_mcp: yes. This is a docs/implementation-pattern MCP, not a product-management MCP (management goes through `clerk api`)
mcp.one_click: `clerk mcp install` registers it in every detected client (Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code), non-interactive in agent mode; `clerk doctor` verifies reachability

docs_for_agents.md_pages: append .md to any /docs, /blog, /changelog URL; helpful 404 .md pages list indexes
docs_for_agents.openapi: https://clerk.com/openapi.json (Backend), FAPI and Platform API specs
docs_for_agents.use_with_ai_page: https://clerk.com/agents (incl. LLM leaderboard of models writing Clerk code, updated 2026-09-30)

score_justification: Keyless dev mode means zero human steps to a working integration, plus an agent-mode CLI, SKILL.md and a well-known skills index. Clerk's MCP is docs-only, though.
best_practice: Keyless mode: start building with temporary dev keys and claim the account later. Also publishes /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json.
biggest_gap: No product-management MCP (MCP only serves snippets, Beta); workspace/billing/logs only in the dashboard
enabler_features: OAuth server with Dynamic Client Registration + Client ID Metadata Documents (CIMD) + Device Authorization Grant for MCP servers; build-mcp-server guides for Next.js/Express
M2M tokens and machines with scopes
API keys product (create/verify/revoke for user or org)
Agent Tasks (Beta): mint a URL that creates a session on behalf of a user for agent/test flows
CLI one-liner to switch CIMD/DCR on: `npx clerk api instance/oauth_application_settings -X PATCH`
